records.excerpt: The official Local Nature Reserves (England) FeatureServer identifies Local Nature Reserves as statutory designations and exposes the Natural England polygon layer through a queryable ArcGIS feature service.
records.web_line_scope: official FeatureServer service description and layer listing
records.record_scope: official service identity, statutory-designation description and query service availability

records.excerpt: The Natural England layer is a polygon feature layer with display field NAME and published fields including OBJECTID, REF_CODE, NAME, MEASURE and LABEL; it supports bounded JSON queries.
records.web_line_scope: official layer name, geometry type, fields and supported operations
records.record_scope: official layer schema and bounded query capability

records.excerpt: Natural England publishes the Local Nature Reserves (England) dataset. It is indicative rather than definitive, has no public access constraints, and its licence information identifies the Open Government Licence with Natural England and Ordnance Survey attribution requirements.
records.web_line_scope: publisher, summary, access constraints, attribution and licence sections
records.record_scope: official publisher, dataset interpretation boundary and reuse conditions

records.excerpt: Natural England and Defra guidance describes local nature reserves as managed land protecting wildlife, habitats and natural features, with scientific, educational and recreational roles.
records.web_line_scope: official guidance heading, purpose and management description
records.record_scope: official designation meaning and interpretation boundary

records.excerpt: Natural England guidance explains that its geographic information is available as GIS downloads and interactive maps and identifies open-data and copyright conditions for using Natural England maps and data.
records.web_line_scope: official access formats and open-data/copyright sections
records.record_scope: official access method and reuse boundary

records.excerpt: Open Government Licence version 3 permits copying, publishing, distributing, adapting and commercially or non-commercially exploiting covered information subject to attribution and stated exemptions.
